setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1 to 4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, in C major. The sequencer is stopped. Channel 1's output is a test device whose parameter Control 1 sends MIDI CC 1 from 0 to 127 and has an Off position shown as X. No value is stored for Control 1 yet. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Choose the test device on channel 1's Device screen. Tap K1 to open the norns PARAMS menu, go to MOSAIC, open channel 1's device parameters and turn E2 to Control 1. It reads X: Off, so no CC is sent.
steps.title: Select Control 1

steps.caption: Turn E3 one detent right from X. Control 1 reads 0 and sends MIDI CC 1 with value 0.
steps.title: Turn up from X to 0

steps.caption: Turn E3 one detent right. Control 1 reads 1 and sends MIDI CC 1 with value 1. Each detent moves the value by one.
steps.title: One more detent

steps.caption: Keep turning E3 right until Control 1 reads 64, passing 63. In the MIDI strip, CC 1 shows 63 and then 64.
steps.title: Turn up to the middle

steps.caption: Keep turning E3 right until Control 1 reads 126, one below the highest value.
steps.title: Turn up to just below the top

steps.caption: Turn E3 right once more: Control 1 reads 127, the highest value, and sends MIDI CC 1 with 127. One more turn leaves it at 127.
steps.title: Turn up to the top and stop

steps.caption: Turn E3 left: the value falls to 64, then 1, then to X, which means Off: no CC is sent. One more turn down stays at X. The last frame shows Control 1 back at X.
steps.title: Turn down to X
